an3.5:1.1: “Bhikkhus, one who possesses three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.5:1.3: (1) He formulates a question carelessly; (2) he replies to a question carelessly; (3) when another person replies to a question carefully, with well-rounded and coherent words and phrases, he does not approve of it.
an3.5:1.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.5:2.1: “One who possesses three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.5:2.3: (1) He formulates a question carefully; (2) he replies to a question carefully; (3) when another person replies to a question carefully, with well-rounded and coherent words and phrases, he approves of it.
an3.5:2.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.5:2.5: “Therefore … It is in this way that you should train yourselves.”
